role_sought: President of the Republic of Cyprus (independent candidate backed by DIKO, EDEK and DIPA)
result: First place; qualified for the run-off
opponent: Andreas Mavroyiannis (independent, AKEL-backed), 29.59%; Averof Neofytou (DISY), 26.11%; Christos Christou (ELAM), 6.04%
detail: Fourteen candidates stood; no one won a majority, so the two leading candidates went to a run-off a week later. Turnout was about 72% of 561,273 registered voters. Neofytou's elimination meant that DISY, the party that had struck Christodoulides off its register, was absent from the second round; outgoing President Anastasiades then backed Christodoulides.

role_sought: President of the Republic of Cyprus
opponent: Andreas Mavroyiannis (independent, backed by AKEL), 189,335 votes (48.03%)
detail: Official results of the Ministry of the Interior's Central Electoral Service; turnout 72.45%. He took office on 28 February 2023 for a five-year term.
